title: Hot Water Boiler - Circulation Rates
description: Calculate boiler power and water flow relationships in imperial and SI units. Determine circulated water flow based on boiler capacity and temperature drop.

components.content:
## Hot Water Boiler - Circulation Rates

Boiler power and water flow - Imperial and SI-units.

The relation between:
- Boiler capacity (or power)
- Temperature drop of the water flow in a system serviced by boiler
- Circulated water flow

are indicated in the diagrams below.

## Conversion Factors

**Flow Rate Conversions:**
- 1 gal (US)/min = 6.30888×10⁻⁵ m³/s = 0.0227 m³/h = 0.06309 dm³(liter)/s = 2.228×10⁻³ ft³/s = 0.1337 ft³/min = 0.8327 Imperial gal (UK)/min

**Power Conversions:**
- 1 hp (English horse power) = 745.7 W = 0.746 kW = 550 ft lb/s = 2,545 Btu/h
- 1 Btu/h = 0.293 W
- 1 kW = 3,412 Btu/h = 1.341 British hp

## Example

A boiler with capacity **50 kW** increases the temperature of the circulated water by **20 °C** - the water flow through the boiler is **0.6 kg/s**
